after: The minimum interval between attack starts is 0.30 seconds.

before: A custom rule is the sequential dependency between Key 1 and Key 2. The player must first clear Room B to obtain Key 1 and unlock Room D, then clear Room D to obtain Key 2 and unlock Room E.

A new attack can begin only when at least 0.30 seconds have elapsed since the previous attack started.

before: The actual room transition is still performed during the unified room-transition stage.
after: The actual room transition is performed during the unified room-transition stage.

before: - Right-side door → message appears to the left
after: - Right-side door message appears to the left.

before: 2. Process a new Space key-down event and begin an attack if the attack cooldown allows it.
